turns.user_utterance: What is the process for activating my card?
turns.assistant_response: To activate your card, you can usually do it in the app: open the Revolut app (or your banking app), go to Cards, select your new card, and tap Activate. If your card requires additional verification, follow the on-screen prompts. If you tell me whether you have a physical or virtual card (and whether it’s already linked to the app), I can guide you step by step.
